changeSet.author: edward
changeSet.comment: Create the account-level Azure Blob storage integration.
changeSet.sql: CREATE STORAGE INTEGRATION IF NOT EXISTS AZURE_BLOB_STORAGE_INT TYPE = EXTERNAL_STAGE STORAGE_PROVIDER = 'AZURE' ENABLED = TRUE AZURE_TENANT_ID = '${azure.tenant.id}' STORAGE_ALLOWED_LOCATIONS = ( 'azure://${azure.storage.account}.blob.core.windows.net/${azure.container}/${azure.blob.prefix}/' )

rollback.sql: DROP STORAGE INTEGRATION IF EXISTS AZURE_BLOB_STORAGE_INT

changeSet.author: edward
changeSet.comment: Create the account-level Azure queue notification integration.
changeSet.sql: CREATE NOTIFICATION INTEGRATION IF NOT EXISTS AZURE_SNOWPIPE_NOTIFICATION_INT ENABLED = TRUE TYPE = QUEUE NOTIFICATION_PROVIDER = AZURE_STORAGE_QUEUE AZURE_STORAGE_QUEUE_PRIMARY_URI = 'https://${azure.storage.account}.queue.core.windows.net/${azure.queue}' AZURE_TENANT_ID = '${azure.tenant.id}'

rollback.sql: DROP NOTIFICATION INTEGRATION IF EXISTS AZURE_SNOWPIPE_NOTIFICATION_INT
